_meta.measurement_source: 00_REFERENCE/supplementary/fox_v2_turnaround_front_34_side.png and fox_v2_turnaround_back_views.png (each view cropped to 724x724 px), cross-checked against 00_REFERENCE/FOX_V2_BASELINE.png
_meta.pixel_origin: front view crop: fox centre line x=455 px, ground (bottom of feet) y=670 px
_meta.normalisation: model units = metres; total height (ground to ear tip) 642 px -> 1.000 m; 1 px = 0.001558 m
_meta.axes: Blender Z-up, character faces -Y, +X = character's LEFT side, ground at Z=0

confidence_legend.measured: read directly from the orthographic-looking front/side/back turnaround (+-5 px, i.e. +-0.008 m)
confidence_legend.estimated: inferred from perspective views or occluded areas; treat as design intent, not a measurement
confidence_legend.decided: chosen to resolve a contradiction between views; see visual_spec.md section 'Discrepancies'

head_height_incl_ears_ratio.note: ear tip to chin / total height

head.shape: wide mochi/onigiri dome, flat-ish underside, horizontal fluff ridge at cheek height that is visible from front and back
head.construction_r4: lower half is an exact ellipse (exponent 1.75) from the chin pole z 0.389 to the equator z 0.575; one continuous lower-face swell for cheeks + muzzle

face_mask_cream.shape: large horizontal ellipse covering the lower face; eyes sit on the orange just above its top edge

eyes.shape: vertical dark-brown ovals, no white sclera, glossy, very slight dome

mouth.shape: cat 'w' / omega line, dark brown, rounded ends

ears.inner_ear: cream, ~60% of ear width, from 12% to 85% of ear height; not visible from the back

orientation_r2.value: outward tilt 9 deg, yaw 8 deg, lean back 12 deg
orientation_r2.note: r1 was 16/16/13; relaxed per Gate C review

ears.construction_r2: U-shaped bowl cross-section (rounded rim lip at |x|>0.78w), round dome tip (last 16% of height), cream lining shell inside the bowl
ears.construction_r3: r2 U-bowl and dome tip kept; upper half widened (taper exponent 0.68, tip radius 0.058 m)
ears.construction_r4: back fullness grows with height (0.75 -> 1.05 x depth); ear arcs 0.032 m backward toward the tip; tip depth 0.056 m

hair_tuft.position: top-front of crown, sweeping forward like a wave crest

body.shape: short rounded pear/egg, slightly wider at the hips

arms.paw_marking: dark brown on lower ~45% of arm

side.reason: Gate C r3 user decision (option C): matches the hero illustration, 3/4 view and back view; the front turnaround's mirrored tail is treated as the reference inconsistency

tail.relative_to_body: tail volume is about as large as the torso; teardrop curling up, back and outward
tail.cream_tip: upper ~32% of tail length, zig-zag boundary with ~5 teeth
tail.construction_r4: 8-point spine, soft inward curl at the tip, longer rounded end cap (34 %)

scarf.construction: bunched roll around the neck + bandana triangle on the chest; no visible knot or loose tails in any view

backpack.flap: covers upper ~55%, gold square buckle centred on flap bottom
backpack.straps: two straps over the shoulders, visible on the chest at x=+-0.14 between z 0.22 and 0.34
backpack.side_pockets: small pocket on each side (side view)

level_scale.note: uniform scale of the whole character root; values from the brief, configurable in app code
